items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he invited me to come by for about five dollars a lesson or some figure like that

ctx.x: I had a friend that was playing in the club across the street from the ballroom where I was playing that evening. I went over afterwards to hear Joe Puma and opposite him was [this] Latin band with Tristano in it, and I said: “wow, who is that?”. . . [I] heard him playing with locked-hands figures very interestingly, and against those rhythms. He (Puma) introduced me and he (Tristano) said: “why, you want to play a little bit?” and I played a couple tunes and said I would really appreciate getting some more…
What are some of the things you talked about in the lessons?
